{
  "decisions": [
    {
      "decision": "machine_assignment",
      "evidence": "\"All operations are assigned to shared machines\" / \"For every pair of operations assigned to the same machine\"",
      "options": [
        "op1 -> machine 1, op2 -> machine 2 (two machines, 5 ops each)",
        "all operations on a single shared machine",
        "each operation on its own dedicated machine (no sharing)"
      ],
      "plausibility": [
        0.6,
        0.3,
        0.1
      ],
      "majority_option": "op1 -> machine 1, op2 -> machine 2 (two machines, 5 ops each)"
    },
    {
      "decision": "start_time_domain",
      "evidence": "\"The decision variables include the start time of each operation\"",
      "options": [
        "NonNegativeReals",
        "NonNegativeIntegers",
        "Reals"
      ],
      "plausibility": [
        0.7,
        0.25,
        0.05
      ],
      "majority_option": "NonNegativeReals"
    },
    {
      "decision": "makespan_definition",
      "evidence": "\"The makespan must be at least as large as the completion time of every operation.\"",
      "options": [
        "makespan >= start + proc_time for every operation (completion time)",
        "makespan >= start for every operation (start time only)",
        "makespan = max completion time (equality)"
      ],
      "plausibility": [
        0.85,
        0.1,
        0.05
      ],
      "majority_option": "makespan >= start + proc_time for every operation (completion time)"
    },
    {
      "decision": "precedence_gap_direction",
      "evidence": "\"the start time of the second operation must be at least 1 unit after the start time of the first operation\"",
      "options": [
        "start[j,2] >= start[j,1] + 1",
        "start[j,2] >= start[j,1] + proc_time (same as +1 here)",
        "start[j,2] > start[j,1] + 1 (strict)"
      ],
      "plausibility": [
        0.8,
        0.15,
        0.05
      ],
      "majority_option": "start[j,2] >= start[j,1] + 1"
    },
    {
      "decision": "disjunctive_bigM_form",
      "evidence": "\"enforced by binary decision variables that determine the order of operations on the machine. A large constant (100,000) is used\"",
      "options": [
        "two constraints with y and (1-y) using big-M on both",
        "single constraint per pair with big-M on one side only",
        "big-M applied only to the non-precedence direction"
      ],
      "plausibility": [
        0.75,
        0.15,
        0.1
      ],
      "majority_option": "two constraints with y and (1-y) using big-M on both"
    },
    {
      "decision": "objective_sense",
      "evidence": "\"the total completion time, or makespan, is minimized\"",
      "options": [
        "minimize makespan",
        "maximize makespan"
      ],
      "plausibility": [
        0.98,
        0.02
      ],
      "majority_option": "minimize makespan"
    }
  ]
}
